claims.harm: combining consensus-critical behavior change with structural refactoring increases the risk of subtle consensus bugs
claims.quote: Approach NACK. The recent consensus bug in the BIP110 soft fork proposal in this exact area indicates we need to be extra careful, which isn't the case in this PR yet. I left a ton of suggestions as I recreated the change locally, experimenting with a few different implementations. We should definitely split the two intertwined functionalities, but not in the same PR that also modifies the behavior.

claims.harm: potential single-threaded validation performance regression from using checkqueue with no worker threads
claims.quote: what makes you say this doesn't introduce any regression? I've been trying to measure the -assumevalid=0 -par=1 case for almost a week now. master finished in 60 hours; this branch is still running...
claims.settled_by_quote: I managed to run -par=1 on a different server, it has very similar performance.

claims.harm: dropping script execution caching in TestBlockValidity introduces validation delays at block submission time
claims.quote: Besides, i think this is a regression to remove script execution caching from TBV. This introduces additional delay at block submission time, doing work that was already performed at block template generation time.
claims.settled_by_quote: I have now re-introduced caching in the same commit and fixed the commit message accordingly.
